**Visual observations from test image:**
- Corn leaf/husk-like structure (appears to be leaf sheath or young ear area)
- Dark brown to black oval/irregular spots, moderate size (not tiny pinpoints)
- Fewer spots scattered across the surface
- Spots appear dark throughout with slightly irregular edges

**Comparison with Tar spot reference:**
- Tar spot shows numerous tiny black pinpoint stromata densely scattered — the test image has larger, fewer, more oval spots that don't match this pattern well

**Reasoning through candidates:**
- **Tar spot**: Eliminated — reference shows tiny pinpoints, test shows larger oval spots
- **Physoderma brown spot**: Dark brown spots on leaf blades and sheaths — oval dark spots match this profile
- **Eyespot**: Small circular spots with tan center/dark halo — possible but spots in test appear more uniformly dark
- **Anthracnose leaf spot**: Dark brown/black lesions on leaves — possible

The spots are dark brown/black, oval-shaped, on green corn tissue (appears to be leaf sheath area). The distribution and morphology best align with **Physoderma_brown_spot**, which produces dark brown spots on corn leaves and sheaths.
